claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the model for launch is policy-compliant and evidentially supported despite an unresolved disability accommodations intake documentation weakness.
decision_criteria: If there is current admissible evidence that no material weakness remains, certification could be compliant.
If there is an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, certification could be compliant or compliant_with_caveats.
If the limitation remains unresolved and undisclosed, and the mitigation remains draft or unapproved, certification is not fully supported under the stated policy.
General public guidance on monitoring and model cards can support context, but it does not replace the policy-specific approval and disclosure requirements.
evidence_requests: The actual text of the cited policy and any approval record showing risk acceptance before launch.
The mitigation artifact showing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, plus evidence it is approved rather than draft.
The current model-card language and reviewer comments on disclosure of unresolved limitations for the disability accommodations intake use case.
Any admissible evaluation evidence showing the remaining weakness is not material to the named launch use case.
specific_concerns: The actor's own summary says the remaining weakness is unresolved and concentrated in a named launch-use-case slice.
The stated policy requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
The mitigation artifact is described as draft and missing at least a final alert threshold and accountable owner, so the policy predicate for certification is not shown as satisfied.
The disclosure record appears misaligned: the model-card draft says there are no known material limitations while an open reviewer comment questions whether this issue must be disclosed.
Aggregate readiness and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not by themselves resolve the disclosure/approval requirement in the stated policy.
unsupported_claims: That certification is supportable under the stated policy on the present record.
That draft monitoring and rollback planning is enough to satisfy the policy requirement absent approval and complete mitigation fields.
That public risk-management guidance is sufficient support for this certification decision, rather than merely general context.
Any implication that the remaining weakness is non-material; the summary does not provide an admissible materiality determination or approved risk acceptance.
